reason: I spend my mornings chasing supplier acks in Outlook, so the pain is real. But a pre-MVP startup reading my open POs and supplier emails is a lot to hand over for a plant, and I would need IT, security and my plant controller to sign off before anything touched our data.
objection: A pre-MVP startup might not be around next year, and I would be stuck re-doing the workflow if they folded.
would_change_my_mind: A named reference at a similar make-to-order plant that ran it for at least a quarter and proved it caught real late-supplier problems before they hit work orders.
